jobDescription: Job Title Cloud Migration Architect – AWS (End-to-End Infrastructure Transformation) Expected Work Experience 12+ years of IT experience, with: 5+ years in AWS cloud architecture. Job Location Not specified Job Summary The Lead Cloud Architect is the technical authority and design owner for cloud migration and modernisation programme. They are accountable for defining the end-to-end cloud strategy, shaping the Landing Zone architecture, and overseeing all technical designs and implementation across AWS infrastructure, security, identity, networking, migration planning, and EUC (Amazon Work Spaces / Citrix modernisation). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and governing migration strategies across infrastructure, applications, network, and security layers. This role ensures that all architectural decisions are aligned to the functional, non-functional, financial, and security requirements, including resilience, Conditional Access, CIS/NCSC compliance, and cost efficiency. The Lead Architect provides technical governance across all phases: Discovery, Strategy & Design, Landing Zone Build, Amazon Work Spaces deployment, Pilot & Full Migration, and BAU transition. This role requires deep expertise in migration engineering, cloud architecture, security, and automation, with proven delivery of large-scale, zero/near-zero downtime migrations. The role also requires close coordination with project managers, program managers, stakeholders, and vendors throughout migration engagements, including managing technical dependencies and communication flows, and designing pragmatic migration approaches that balance speed, risk, and cloud capability adoption under strict time-constrained scenarios such as data center exit deadlines. Key Responsibilities Architectural Leadership & Technical Governance Act as the overall technical design authority, ensuring cohesion across all workstreams. Lead workshops with SMEs to validate requirements. Own and maintain the Cloud Architecture Blueprint. Conduct architecture assurance across offshore and onshore teams. Chair and drive the Technical Design Authority (TDA) process. Discovery, Assessment & Cloud Strategy Lead and validate discovery findings. Develop Target Architecture and Migration Roadmap. Produce cloud adoption strategy aligned to public-sector frameworks. Landing Zone Design & Governance Controls Design secure multi-account AWS Landing Zone. Define SCP guardrails, IAM role model, logging, monitoring, KMS strategy. Ensure compliance with CIS, NCSC, Cyber Essentials. Oversee network segmentation, VPC connectivity, and DR patterns. EUC & Amazon Work Spaces / Citrix Modernisation Design Lead architecture for virtual desktop estate. Oversee FSLogix, conditional access, MFA, RBAC. Provide technical assurance during UAT and rollout. Migration Planning & Execution Governance Own migration architecture, runbooks, and cutover plans. Select pilot workloads and define success criteria. Oversee AWS MGN/Cloud Endure migrations. Provide technical escalation during cutovers. Apply and advocate phased migration approaches such as “migrate–manage–modernize” (or equivalent), including justifying this approach to stakeholders and planning modernization as a follow-on phase. Security, Identity & Compliance Assurance Ensure encryption, MFA, identity federation, patching, and threat detection. Embed compliance into solution design. Oversee security engineer deliverables. Operational Readiness, Hypercare & BAU Transition Define operational model, dashboards, alerting rules. Lead defect triage and tuning during hypercare. Shape steady-state governance and Fin Ops optimisation. Infrastructure & Platform Migration Design and execute migration for: Compute: EC2, Auto Scaling, AMI-based builds. Storage: S3, EBS, EFS, FSx (Windows & Lustre). File Servers: NFS, SMB, DFS migration strategies. Backup & DR: AWS Backup, lifecycle policies, cross-region replication. Application servers (IIS, Apache, Web Sphere, etc.). File shares and network drives. Printer services and legacy dependencies. Design and execute mixed migration patterns (rehost, re-platform, and partial greenfield builds) across Windows, Linux, and SAP workloads, including creating target resources from scratch where needed. Optimize: Cost (Fin Ops principles), performance (right-sizing, autoscaling). Security & Compliance Establish enterprise-grade cloud security posture: Encryption (at rest/in transit via KMS). Secrets management (Secrets Manager / Parameter Store). Security monitoring (Guard Duty, Security Hub). Implement: Firewall policies and intrusion detection/prevention. Compliance controls (ISO, SOC2, GDPR where relevant). Incorporate vendor lock-in risks and application-team constraints (such as hesitancy or limited capacity to modernize) into pragmatic migration designs and roadmaps. Key Deliverables Cloud Adoption Strategy. Target Architecture (HLD/LLD). Landing Zone Architecture Pack. Detailed Implementation Plan. EUC/Work Spaces/Citrix design. Migration Strategy & Runbooks. Security & Compliance Architecture. Operational Readiness & Handover Packs. Other Capabilities Required Skills & Experience 10+ years cloud architecture; 5+ years AWS in regulated sectors. Deep knowledge of: AWS Organisations, Control Tower, IAM, VPC, Work Spaces, App Stream, FSLogix, AWS MGN, Terraform/Cloud Formation, KMS, Guard Duty, Cloud Trail, Entra ID. Strong stakeholder communication. Experience defining governance, stage-gate assurance. Experience coordinating directly with project managers, program managers, stakeholders, and vendors throughout migration engagements. Experience working within strict time-constrained migration scenarios and articulating trade-offs between speed, risk, and cloud capability adoption. Experience advocating phased migration approaches such as “migrate–manage–modernize” and planning modernization as a follow-on phase. Experience managing vendor lock-in risks and application-team constraints within migration roadmaps. Soft Skills Strong communicator. Structured thinker. Risk-focused. Delivery-oriented. Deep knowledge of: Networking (BGP, VPNs, routing), firewalls and security architectures. Experience with: Backup & disaster recovery strategies, NFS/SMB file systems, enterprise application hosting patterns. Hands-on experience designing and executing mixed migration patterns (rehost, re-platform, and partial greenfield builds) across Windows, Linux, and SAP workloads. Experience leveraging and extending existing Ia C templates (Terraform/Cloud Formation) provided by client teams to fit into existing enterprise standards, rather than only building greenfield landing zones.
